producer_order: one F11 converter/main plan per codec source

accepted_candidate_boundary.global_commit_gate: after complete frame and the source transaction's durable append gate

failure_boundary.failed_candidate: discard candidate scratch; retain the same fixed source plan for the next candidate
failure_boundary.all_candidates_fail: fatal source; discard staged roots under the source transaction contract
failure_boundary.f11_producer_failure: before F12 trials; no candidate loop

snr_name_guard: F11 converter_snr_offset is a U16 10-bit plan result; it is distinct from F12's two-bit SNR offset strategy syntax value 0.
